title: Amazonian tribesmen identify a grey as Makunwabu

tellings.quote: They found an alien gray and they showed this alien gray and the Amazonian tribe and went that's Makunwabu.

plain: When people showed a tribe in the Amazon an image of an alien grey, the small grey-skinned being of many UFO stories, the tribesmen said it was Makunwabu, a being they already knew. Jay Anderson, a UFO researcher, tells Michels this as something he was told. If true, it would mean the same beings appear in old native traditions.
